status.title: Status Management
status.description: Transitions follow rules; every change, including automatic ones, is recorded.
status.cancelledBanner: This auction was cancelled; its status can no longer change.

effect.publish: The auction is scheduled and goes live automatically at its start time.
effect.startNow: The auction goes live immediately instead of waiting for its planned start; invited suppliers are notified.
effect.resume: Bidding continues where it left off. The paused duration is added to the end time.
effect.reopen: The ended auction opens for bidding again until the new end time.
effect.pause: Bidding stops temporarily and the clock is frozen. Suppliers are notified with the reason.
effect.endNow: The auction closes immediately and moves to bid evaluation.
effect.unpublish: The auction is unpublished and returns to draft; it can be edited and published again.
effect.cancel: The auction is cancelled permanently and this cannot be undone. Suppliers are notified with the reason.
effect.requestApproval: Publishing auctions in your company requires Admin approval. It is sent for approval with the dates you choose; once approved the auction is scheduled and suppliers are notified.
